# Synthetic_Data_Augmentation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
Using generative models to create additional training samples that preserve statistical properties of real patient data. Reduces data scarcity in medical domains, allowing TCC/iNEST prototypes to be validated on larger, more diverse datasets.
